title: Apricot Flan
description: Not just dessert — this is the one that makes the room go quiet. Soft custard, buttery pastry, and apricots that know their job.

method.instruction: Combine flour, sugar, ground almonds, and butter. Rub together until crumbly, then bring together into a dough. Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll pastry out and line a flan tin. Blind bake until lightly golden, then cool completely.
Beat egg yolks with sugar and vanilla. Gradually add warm milk, then cook gently until thickened. Cool slightly and fold through whipped cream.
Fill cooled pastry shell with custard. Arrange apricot halves over the top.
Warm apricot jam with brandy and brush over fruit. Finish with flaked almonds and chill until set.

notes.title: Make Ahead
notes.content: The pastry shell can be baked a day in advance. Assemble the flan on the day of serving to keep the base crisp.

notes.title: Brandy
notes.content: To retain alcohol content, remove the pan from heat before adding. If the recipe calls for flambéing, that's intentional — but for sauces and braises where you want the flavour without burning off the alcohol, keep the heat low and never boil after adding.
